# Temple Scroll Column 51 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 51 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**51:1** You shall not see the ox of your brother or his sheep being driven-away and hide yourself from them; returning, you shall return them to your brother.

**51:2** And if your brother is not near to you, or you do not know him, then you shall gather it into the midst of your house, and it shall be with you until your brother seeks it, and you shall return it to him.

**51:3** And thus you shall do for his donkey, and thus you shall do for his garment, and thus you shall do for every lost-thing of your brother which is lost from him and you find it; you are not able to hide yourself.

**51:4** You shall not see the donkey of your brother or his ox falling in the way, and hide yourself from them; raising-up, you shall raise it up with him.

**51:5** There shall not be the vessel of a man upon a woman, and a man shall not put on the garment of a woman; for an abomination of the LORD your God is everyone doing these things.

**51:6** When a bird's nest chances before you in the way, in any tree or upon the ground, with chicks or eggs, and the mother is sitting upon the chicks or upon the eggs, you shall not take the mother upon the sons.

**51:7** Sending, you shall send away the mother, and the sons you may take for yourself, so that it may go well with you and you may lengthen days.

**51:8** When you build a new house, you shall make a parapet for your roof, and you shall not place blood-guilt upon your house when the one-falling falls from it.

**51:9** You shall not sow your vineyard with two-kinds, lest the fullness become holy — the seed which you sow and the produce of the vineyard.

**51:10** You shall not plow with an ox and with a donkey together.

**51:11** You shall not wear mixed-stuff, wool and linen together.

**51:12** Twisted-cords you shall make for yourself upon the four corners of your covering with which you cover yourself.

**51:13** When a man takes a wife and goes in to her and hates her,

**51:14** and he places against her deeds of words and brings out upon her an evil name and says: This woman I took, and I drew near to her and I did not find in her signs-of-virginity —

**51:15** then the father of the young-woman and her mother shall take and bring out the signs-of-virginity of the young-woman to the elders of the city, to the gate.

**51:16** And the father of the young-woman shall say to the elders: My daughter I gave to this man for a wife, and he hated her.

---

*EMET notes: Column 51 reworks Deuteronomy 22:1-17, preserving the first-person divine voice characteristic of 11Q19. "Signs-of-virginity" (betulim) retained as a compound to preserve the Hebrew construct. "Mixed-stuff" (sha'atnez) rendered literally. "Two-kinds" (kil'ayim) preserved. The sequence follows Deuteronomy closely but integrates the material as direct divine speech.*
